'''Charles Royal Johnson''' (born January 28, 1948) is an American mathematician specializing in [[linear algebra]]. He was a Class of 1961 professor of mathematics at [[College of William and Mary]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.wm.edu/as/mathematics/faculty/directory/johnson_c.php|title=College of William and Mary: faculty|publisher=Wm.edu|accessdate=27 October 2014|url-status=dead|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20141107053438/http://www.wm.edu/as/mathematics/faculty/directory/johnson_c.php|archivedate=7 November 2014}}</ref> The books ''Matrix Analysis'' and ''Topics in Matrix Analysis'', co-written by him with [[Roger Horn]], are standard texts in advanced linear algebra.<ref>{{cite book|title=Matrix Analysis|isbn=0521386322|last1=Horn|first1=Roger A.|last2=Johnson|first2=Charles R.|date=23 February 1990}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.amazon.com/gp/product/0521467136/|title=Topics in Matrix Analysis: Roger A. Horn, Charles R. Johnson: 9780521467131: Amazon.com: Books|publisher=Amazon.com|accessdate=27 October 2014}}</ref><ref name=reviewMarcus>{{cite journal|author=Marcus, Marvin|author-link=Marvin Marcus|title=Review: ''Topics in Matrix Analysis'', by Roger A. Horn and Charles R. Johnson|journal=Bull. Amer. Math. Soc. (N.S.)|year=1992|volume=27|issue=1|pages=191–198|url=https://www.ams.org/journals/bull/1992-27-01/S0273-0979-1992-00296-3/|doi=10.1090/s0273-0979-1992-00296-3|MR=1567985|doi-access=free}}</ref>

== Career ==
Johnson received a B.A. with distinction in Mathematics and Economics from [[Northwestern University]] in 1969. In 1972, he received a Ph.D. in Mathematics and Economics from the [[California Institute of Technology]], where he was advised by [[Olga Taussky Todd]]; his dissertation was entitled "Matrices whose Hermitian Part is Positive Definite".<ref>{{cite web|url=https://thesis.library.caltech.edu/9680/1/Johnson_cr_1972.pdf|title=Matrices whose Hermitian Part is Positive Definite|publisher=caltech.edu|accessdate=27 July 2019|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181102193722/https://thesis.library.caltech.edu/9680/1/Johnson_cr_1972.pdf |archive-date=2018-11-02 }}</ref> Johnson held various professorships over ten years at the [[University of Maryland, College Park]] starting in 1974. He was a professor at [[Clemson University]] from 1984 to 1987.{{citation needed|date=September 2024}} He was a professor of mathematics at the [[College of William and Mary]] from 1987 to 2024.<ref>{{cite web|url = https://www.wm.edu/as/mathematics/faculty-directory/history/ | title = History: Listing of Mathematics Faculty, 1716 to the Present | access-date = 2024-09-03 | website = wm.edu}}</ref>
